title: Standard Evaluation Contract
description: Canonical connector -> harness -> evaluator wire format (Module 6). Additive-only-never-bumps versioning; additional properties are allowed at every level.

contractVersion.description: Integer-as-string identifying the contract version. Compared numerically against the bundled schema version; an instance ahead of the bundled version is rejected at runtime.

utteranceId.description: Globally unique id (UUID v4 or equivalent), generated by the harness when the Utterance is persisted.

utteranceText.description: The original user input from the CSV row's utteranceText column.

testId.description: CSV-supplied identity associated with the row.

conversationContext.description: Reserved for future multi-turn support. MUST be null in v1; a non-null object is permitted forward-compat but evaluators MUST NOT depend on its shape.

connectorId.description: Identity of the connector service that produced this instance (the snapshotted ConnectorRegistration.connectorId).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 / RFC 3339 datetime indicating when the harness constructed this contract instance.

chatbotResponse.description: The connector's rendering of the chatbot response.

rawPayload.description: Opaque raw chatbot response exactly as the connector received it. Shape intentionally unconstrained.

normalizedText.description: The connector's best plain-text rendering of what the chatbot said. Empty string is allowed.

agentChain.description: Ordered list of agent identifiers invoked during response generation. Empty array is valid (non-agentic connectors).

metadata.description: Free-form, connector-specific metadata. Well-known keys: latencyMs (integer), model (string), sources (array), toolCalls (array), conversationId (string — returned by SSE connectors to persist a conversation handle across chat turns). Empty object is valid.

tokenUsage.description: Optional LLM token usage for the chatbot call. Omit entirely for non-LLM connectors. All sub-fields are optional.

promptTokens.description: Tokens consumed by the prompt / input.

completionTokens.description: Tokens consumed by the completion / output.

totalTokens.description: Total tokens consumed. Harness uses this field for per-row and job-level aggregation.
